name: ChampGraph
description: Semantic knowledge graph (Cham_Graph) plus local prospect store. Actions mirror ChampGraphService: PROSPECT_ACTIONS + GRAPH_ACTIONS + CAMPAIGN_ACTIONS. Regenerated 2026-07-21 (SUGGESTIONS 1.5) — keep in sync with champgraph/service.py (drift-guard test enforces).

actions.label: Create Prospect
actions.description: Upsert a prospect in the local store by email.

actions.label: List Prospects
actions.description: List prospects with optional status filter and search.

actions.label: Get Prospect Status
actions.description: Fetch a prospect's current engagement status. Returns engagement_status: cold | sent | opened | replied | sequence_active | sequence_completed | not_found. Use a Switch node on {{ prev.data.engagement_status }} to route to mail engine or calling agent.

actions.label: Bulk Import Prospects
actions.description: Upsert many prospects at once; each record needs an email.

actions.label: Enrich Prospect
actions.description: Local enrichment: merges stored fields and recent event signals. Chain research_prospects after this for LLM enrichment.

actions.label: Ingest Episode
actions.description: Ingest one episode (email/call/note) into the graph for an account.

actions.label: Ingest Batch
actions.description: Bulk-ingest episodes for an account (Graphiti bulk path).

actions.label: Hook: Email
actions.description: Log a single email interaction (simplified flat payload).

actions.label: Hook: Email Batch
actions.description: Log up to 100 email interactions in one call.

actions.label: Hook: Call
actions.description: Log a call with transcript and metadata.

actions.label: Query Graph (NL)
actions.description: Natural-language hybrid search over an account's graph (nodes, edges, communities). This is functionality A's NL surface. Aliases nl_query and semantic_search resolve here.

actions.label: Account: Contacts
actions.description: List contacts known for an account.

actions.label: Account: Topics
actions.description: Topics discussed with an account.

actions.label: Account: Communications
actions.description: Communication edges for an account.

actions.label: Account: Personal Details
actions.description: Personal details (family, hobbies) captured for account contacts.

actions.label: Account: Team Contacts
actions.description: Internal team members connected to an account.

actions.label: Account: Subgraph
actions.description: Full subgraph export for an account.

actions.label: Account: Timeline
actions.description: Cross-channel interaction timeline, chronological.

actions.label: Account: Relationships
actions.description: Relationship edges for an account.

actions.label: Account: Email Context
actions.description: Purpose-built context for email composition (history, personal details, topics).

actions.label: Account: Briefing
actions.description: Comprehensive pre-interaction briefing for an account.

actions.label: Intelligence: Salesperson Overlap
actions.description: Cross-salesperson discovery for an account.

actions.label: Intelligence: Stakeholder Map
actions.description: Champions, blockers, decision-makers for an account.

actions.label: Intelligence: Engagement Gaps
actions.description: Stale contacts / engagement gap detection.

actions.label: Intelligence: Cross-Branch
actions.description: Combined opportunities across branches/divisions.

actions.label: Intelligence: Opportunities
actions.description: Opportunity detection with stakeholder roles.

actions.label: Sync: Account
actions.description: Trigger a sync for one account.

actions.label: Sync: Status
actions.description: Sync status across accounts.

actions.label: Campaign: Research Prospects
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: research stage. Free-form inputs forwarded to the pipeline.

actions.label: Campaign: Essence
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: essence stage.

actions.label: Campaign: Segment
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: segmentation stage.

actions.label: Campaign: Pitch
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: pitch stage.

actions.label: Campaign: Personalize
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: personalization stage.

actions.label: Campaign: HTML
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: HTML generation stage.

actions.label: Campaign: Preview
actions.description: AI campaign pipeline: preview stage.

actions.description: Deprecated alias of `query` kept for old workflows. Use query with account_name + query.
